paired_view_audit.interpretation: The old field scaffold materially changes candidate recovery in most steps. Types recurring in both views are stronger evidence; schema-only candidates remain provisional until independent direct-chart review.
paired_view_audit.causal_boundary: Both views use ex-ante text only. ACR, verification, deviation, current-result, later-event, and final-diagnosis fields were excluded.

other_unclear_audit.interpretation: Zero residual assignments is not evidence that the residual categories are unnecessary. The deterministic rules can overassign familiar types and cannot adjudicate semantic ambiguity.
other_unclear_audit.required_action: Retain other and unclear in every contract; manually review weakly supported, multi-purpose, and unsupported-order cases in the independent framework check.

boundary_cases.decision: Create separate disease_or_finding_identity and etiology_or_mechanism propositions with independent statuses.

boundary_cases.case: Broad source search versus named competing diagnosis
boundary_cases.decision: Use syndrome_or_source_frame/source_localization for an undifferentiated search; use alternative_source only for a supported competing frame.
Extent or interval change remains severity_or_extent; a distinct adverse entity is complication, and both can coexist.
Device position/function is intervention_or_device_state; leak, infection, hemorrhage, or injury is complication.
Only an adequate assessment can provide a negative answer. Nonvisualized, nondiagnostic, and not assessed remain separate.

over_rationalization_risks: The actual order was visible to the original annotator and may make intent look more coherent than the chart supports.
Appropriateness and action-role wording can import modality-centered explanations into a question that should be decision-centered.
Lexical matches can turn mentions of a complication or device into a top-level question even when it is only background context.
A broad differential can be overcompressed into one source-localization question or overexpanded into many unsupported secondary questions.
The old information_gap and expected_finding fields can induce requirement labels that do not emerge from reasoning-only text.
adjudication_rules: Prefer the smallest evidence-supported atomic proposition and question.
Require exact pre-order quotations for every proposition, question, and coverage entry.
Mark support weak or unclear when the order, rather than visible evidence, supplies most of the rationale.
Preserve an unsupported residual and an alternative reconstruction instead of forcing agreement.
Promote an other cluster only after it recurs in fresh development cases and has a stable inclusion/exclusion boundary.
